# NBC/NXC compiler

`nbc.exe` is the NBC/NXC compiler by John Hansen, version 1.2.1.r5, from the BricxCC test release
of 2011-10-24 (http://bricxcc.sourceforge.net/). It is distributed under the Mozilla Public License 1.1.
Its source code is available from the BricxCC project.

NXT Studio runs it to turn block programs (as generated NXC) into `.rxe` files that are then
downloaded to the brick. The build copies it to `tools\nbc.exe` next to `NXTStudio.exe`.
